analysis.dataset: Gabriele et al. 2022 Fbn2 paired-locus tracking
analysis.cell_state: G1/early S-phase selected in source study
analysis.processing: QC-filtered coordinates; duplicate frames use the last source row, verified against author H5;  R(t)=r_mScarlet(t)-r_EGFP(t); average |R(t+lag)-R(t)|^2 over all valid exact-frame-lag pairs; no interpolation across gaps.
analysis.maximum_lag_rule: At most half the nominal 365-frame recording duration; pairs are included only where both measured endpoints exist.

distance_statistics.moment_caveat: 2 E[|R|^2] is the tutorial second-moment proxy, not a directly observed long-lag plateau; equality requires stationary decorrelated zero-mean pair vectors.

suggested_fit_window.selection: Fixed exploratory window, excludes first two lags and long-lag tail; model stationarity, sensitivity and shape agreement must still be checked.
